hit.action: single compact recoil from an impact at the left: Argus leans back, body eyes narrow, both feet remain visible, and the complete eye staff stays nearly vertical in the hand; center within the middle 68 percent width and 76 percent height with broad padding; no loose eye, wound, beam, debris, or crop

death.action: two-frame non-graphic defeat facing left: knees buckle, then Argus settles into a low seated collapse while the complete eye staff stays held or directly touching the hand and every body eye remains embedded; compact poses with broad gutters; no loose eye, blood, gore, detached staff part, debris, or cross-slot pixel
